study_catalog.label: Agentic improvement lab v1 · DeepSeek v4.1 Flash
study_catalog.description: This open-ended study iteratively improves the decomposition harness while holding the model fixed at `deepseek-v4.1-flash`. It is intentionally not a precomputed treatment-by-system campaign. Each child trial records one primary architectural intervention, its parent, immutable observations, and a keep/reject/inconclusive decision.

study_catalog.label: Final benchmark extension v1
study_catalog.description: **Status (2026-10-19): integrated.** The authors decided to make these runs the main results of the TSE paper: the primary analysis is 8 models × 4 systems × 5 runs, the 31 unreadable outputs count as failed runs, and the first benchmark stays as a supporting view (`papers/tse-2026/INTEGRATION_PLAN.md`, `analysis/README.md`). The text below is the collection log as written at the time.

study_catalog.label: Final benchmark v1
study_catalog.description: Planned cross-model benchmark of the finalized agentic workflow ([`agentic-final`](../../protocols/decomposer-configs/agentic-final/README.md)). The protocol is [`protocols/campaigns/final-benchmark-v1.yaml`](../../protocols/campaigns/final-benchmark-v1.yaml).

study_catalog.label: Harness Baselines V1
study_catalog.description: This study contains 140 available observations produced with existing agentic harnesses: Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, and OpenCode/Codex. Coverage reflects what was actually collected; it is not evidence that every harness ran every possible treatment.

study_catalog.label: Harness Repeatability V1
study_catalog.description: This study contains 24 repeated observations used to examine run-to-run behavior of external harness baselines. Repetition is explicit in each manifest; runs are not interchangeable copies and must not be deduplicated by matching prompt or system alone.

study_catalog.label: Icsa 2026
study_catalog.description: This directory preserves the original single-shot LLM study in a normalized, auditable layout.

study_catalog.label: Agentic v1
study_catalog.known_limitation: Treatment source scope was broader than the evaluation inventory.
study_catalog.description: This study is the output location for the original versioned campaign in `protocols/campaigns/matched-agentic-v1.yaml` and its documented completion amendment, `matched-agentic-v1-complete.yaml`. It compares paper-style `80k_concat` and hierarchical treatments, OpenCode class protocols `baseline-1` through `baseline-5`, and `agentic-v2` using one matched requested model. The OpenCode protocols remain separate treatment variants beneath the same harness-and-model family.

study_catalog.label: qwen-35B
study_catalog.description: This is the output location for the corrected matched-model campaign. Paper 80k-concat, paper hierarchical, OpenCode baselines 1–5, and the proposed agentic pipeline all receive one identical, fingerprinted benchmark scope.

study_catalog.label: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash · matched v1
study_catalog.description: This study is the completed ground-baseline campaign for subsequent agentic architecture iterations. It holds the model constant at `deepseek-v4.1-flash` and compares eight treatments on each of the four benchmark systems: paper 80k-concat, paper hierarchical, OpenCode baselines 1–5, and the current `agentic-v2` pipeline.
